mission.title: opentelemetry: GKE Autopilot allowlist onboarding
mission.description: GKE Autopilot allowlist onboarding. Requested by 6+ users.

steps.title: Check current opentelemetry deployment
steps.description:
Verify your opentelemetry version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n opentelemetry -l app.kubernetes.io/name=opentelemetry
helm list -n opentelemetry 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working opentelemetry installation.

steps.title: Review opentelemetry configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant opentelemetry configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n opentelemetry -l app.kubernetes.io/name=opentelemetry
kubectl get configmap -n opentelemetry -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=opentelemetry
```

steps.title: Apply the fix for GKE Autopilot allowlist onboarding
steps.description:
I created a project within the opentelemetry owned Google Cloud account, I provided  and myself with the necessary access to it. To do so I had to rework some of the policies across the opentelemetry.io organization:

* Disable the legacy `iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains`
* Enable
```yaml
apiVersion: auto.gke.io/v1
kind: WorkloadAllowlist
metadata:
  name: ....
  annotations:
    autopilot.gke.io/no-connect: "true"

exemptions:

# Allow host ports for node-local OTLP traffic between monitored workloads and the OpenTelemetry collector DaemonSet pod
# on the same node. (Disclaimer: For some reason the host port usage was not rejected by GKE AP's warden webhook even without a matching exemption, despite Google's documentation saying that host ports require an exemption.)
- autogke-no-host-port

# Allow read-only host volume mount and mapping for "/" to enable the OpenTelemetry hos
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n opentelemetry -l app.kubernetes.io/name=opentelemetry
kubectl get events -n opentelemetry --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "GKE Autopilot allowlist onboarding" is functioning correctly.
